title: The First Patient at Panzi Hospital Had Not Come to Give Birth
conflicts: Lemera toll: Nobel lecture 'more than thirty', Panzi Foundation 2026 'nearly 40'; both given with attribution. Numbers treated: UN News 2016 >40,000, NPR 2016 45,482 (1999-2015), Nobel bio and Right Livelihood >50,000, Panzi 2026 >91,000 across all programmes; story gives NPR's dated figure and the foundation's current one. Right Livelihood implies founding right after 1996 and dates the Nobel to 2019; all other sources give 1999 and 2018. The Nobel lecture's English text says he left Lemera in 1999; the story does not date the departure.
notes: Told without graphic detail, as asked. Founder's own words come from his 2014 Georgetown oral history (also on cfr.org), UN News 2016 and his Nobel lecture. Repeat screen flags Aravind (shared word 'Hospital') but passes.
